screen.chromastudio.title: Chroma Studio
window.chromastudio.pin: Pin: keep this tab on screen while you play. The open key brings the window back.
window.chromastudio.pin.no_world: A window can only be pinned in a world.
window.chromastudio.fullscreen.forced: The game window is too small for anything but fullscreen.
command.chromastudio.bad_hex: "%s" isn't a colour. Use six hex digits, like #ff8800.
command.chromastudio.debug.not_ready: The block index is still being built.
command.chromastudio.unknown_block: There's no block called "%s". Give a block's id, like oak_planks, or a colour, like #ff8800.
command.chromastudio.export.usage: Give a palette's share string, then a layout, a format and "place" if you like: /chroma export chroma1:stone,andesite wall nbt
command.chromastudio.export.unclosed: The share string starts with a double quote and has none to close it.
command.chromastudio.export.unknown_opti: "%s" isn't a layout, a format or "place". The layouts are strip, wall, patch_grid, noise_clusters, height_gradient and dither, and the formats litematic and nbt.
command.chromastudio.export.bad_share: That share string can't be read. %s.
command.chromastudio.export.empty: Nothing was exported, as the palette has no blocks this game knows.
command.chromastudio.export.skipped: Left out: %s. A block is left out when this game doesn't have it or its state, or when the layout is full.
command.chromastudio.place.usage: Give the name of a file in the export folder: /chroma place chroma-stone-strip
command.chromastudio.place.done: Placed "%s" in Litematica at %s, %s, %s. It's selected, so Litematica's tools can move it.
export.chromastudio.litematica.missing: Litematica isn't installed, so there's nothing to place the schematic with. The file is still there.
export.chromastudio.litematica.no_world: A schematic can only be placed in a world.
export.chromastudio.litematica.unreadabl: Litematica couldn't read %s. The file is still there.
export.chromastudio.litematica.failed: Litematica couldn't place the schematic (%s). The file is still there.
settings.chromastudio.title: Chroma Studio settings
settings.chromastudio.reset.tip: Puts this group's settings back to their defaults.
settings.chromastudio.keys.tip: Change the mod's keys in the game's key binds screen.
settings.chromastudio.rememberWindow.tip: Reopens the window where you left it, at the same size and in the same mode. Off, it opens centred at its smallest size.
settings.chromastudio.startTab.tip: The tab the window shows the first time you open it. After that it reopens on the tab you last used.
settings.chromastudio.pinOpacity.tip: How solid a pinned window looks, from 0.2 to 1.
settings.chromastudio.defaultFace.tip: The face of a block that matching looks at when the window opens. Side is the best of the four sides; Any is the best of all six.
settings.chromastudio.shading.tip: Compares faces as the game lights them: sides darker than the top, the bottom darkest.
settings.chromastudio.metric.tip: How the difference between two colours is measured. OKLab matches what the eye sees and is the best choice for most uses.
settings.chromastudio.resultCount.tip: How many blocks a match lists, from 3 to 60.
settings.chromastudio.viewingDistance.ti: How far away you'll look at the build. Further away, a texture's detail blurs into fewer colours. 192 means far.
settings.chromastudio.filterFullCube.tip: Starts matching with only full cubes listed.
settings.chromastudio.filterSolid.tip: Starts matching with only blocks you can't walk through listed.
settings.chromastudio.filterOpaque.tip: Starts matching with only blocks you can't see through listed.
settings.chromastudio.filterSurvival.tip: Starts matching without the blocks you can only get in creative mode, such as bedrock.
settings.chromastudio.showDeltaE.tip: Shows each result's colour difference as a number.
settings.chromastudio.technicalBlocks.ti: Also indexes blocks with no item in the creative inventory.
settings.chromastudio.statesSeparately.t: Lists one row for each state of a block rather than one row per block.
settings.chromastudio.statesCap.tip: The most states kept for one block, from 1 to 8.
Uses the average of an animated texture's frames. Off, only its first frame counts.
settings.chromastudio.cacheFolder.tip: Where the block index is kept between sessions. Leave empty for config/chromastudio/cache.
settings.chromastudio.rebuildOnReload.ti: Rebuilds the block index whenever resource packs reload.
settings.chromastudio.biomeMode.tip: Where grass, leaves and water get their tint: where you stand, the biome chosen below, or every biome as a range.
settings.chromastudio.biome.tip: The biome used when Biome is set to Chosen, as an id like minecraft:plains.
settings.chromastudio.gradientSteps.tip: How many blocks a new gradient has, from 2 to 32.
settings.chromastudio.easing.tip: How a new gradient's colours are spaced between its stops.
settings.chromastudio.hueArc.tip: Which way round the colour wheel a new gradient goes between two stops.
settings.chromastudio.spreadMatching.tip: Prefers blocks whose textures are as busy as their neighbours in the gradient.
settings.chromastudio.generateCount.tip: How many colours Generate makes, from 2 to 32.
settings.chromastudio.captureCount.tip: How many of the commonest blocks Capture keeps, from 1 to 64.
settings.chromastudio.hotbarOverflow.tip: When a palette has more than nine blocks, Hotbar puts the rest in a shulker box. Off, they're left out.
settings.chromastudio.exportFolder.tip: Where exports are saved. Leave empty for Litematica's schematics folder, or the game's schematics folder without Litematica.
settings.chromastudio.defaultLayout.tip: How an export arranges the palette's blocks.
settings.chromastudio.patchSize.tip: The side of each block's square in the patch grid layout, from 1 to 16.
settings.chromastudio.exportGap.tip: Leaves one block of air between entries in an export.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipMode.tip: When an item's tooltip shows its colour: while you hold Shift, always or never.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipSwatch.tip: Shows the block's colour as a swatch.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipHex.tip: Shows the block's colour as a hex code.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipKind.tip: Shows what kind of block it is, such as slab or stairs.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipBadge.tip: Shows whether the texture is flat, grainy or busy.
settings.chromastudio.tooltipDeltaE.tip: Shows how far the block's colour is from the colour you're matching.
settings.chromastudio.readoutSeconds.tip: How long the eyedropper's readout stays on screen, from 1 to 30.
settings.chromastudio.recipeKey.tip: The key that looks up a block's recipe inside the window. Click, then press a key; Escape leaves it unbound.
settings.chromastudio.litematicaPlacemen: Where an exported schematic is placed: at the block you look at, or always where you stand.
